title: Chapter 532
paragraphs: Chapter 532
Episode 145. Omen (1)
From the moment he decided to help the Sword Emperor City, Jin first sought out the Fourth Knight, Diphus, to request protection for Tikan.
Using the information from the Rainbow Bird, he sent Murakan and Quicantel to the Imperial Palace, where the dragon knights were. Danté had also sent Hairan's five sword saints.
Murakan and Quicantel rescued the dragon knights, the five sword saints rescued the baby dragons, and the merger was inevitable.
"The Hairan Dragon Knight Division has come to guard the Sword Emperor City!"
When the Dragon Knight Division Commander, Calmain Aita, shouted, thirty baby dragons roared in unison.
Murakan and Quicantel, who were in charge of the wings of the dragon knight line, also roared.
Just the energy released caused shockwaves and distorted the sky near the dragon knight line.
Along with Calmain's commander dragon, the five leading baby dragons had sword saints standing on them.
The pure white coat symbolizing Hairan's sword saints really looked like stars, as their title suggests.
It was definitely smaller in scale compared to the enemy reinforcements that appeared at the same time.
Ziep had over ten visible flying ships, and the number of dragons was close to twenty. Without any lower species like red dragons, they were all composed of higher species.
What about the magicians aboard the fleet and the dragons?
The flag of the elite troops including Baekya was seen, and even the top secret elite magicians, the Wraith Corps, which had not yet been made public, might be included.
Moreover, there was a high chance that wasn't all.
Yet, as Hairan's knights, just seeing the five sword saints and the dragon knights made their chests full and eyes watery.
Although Ron is still unconscious in bed.
The fact that Hairan's greatest knights and Jin Runcandel were together was forging courage like steel in their hearts.
Murakan and Quicantel took the lead and glared at the enemies.
Everyone on the battlefield could clearly see the dragons of Ziep hesitating at that moment.
Ziep's dragons were clearly afraid of Murakan.
Especially among Ziep's reinforcements were dragons that had directly experienced half of Murakan's strength in the Gaipa army.
Even if they hadn't gone through the nightmare of the Gaipa army.
There were no dragons in the world that didn't know the old reputation of Murakan. Even the young dragons born after Murakan fell asleep spent their time listening to his legend.
[I am Murakan, the one who slaughters the enemies of Solderet.]
The cold yet majestic voice crushed the battlefield.
Ziep's dragons had completely stopped advancing and were fixated on Murakan.
The magicians riding them could not help but feel devastated when they realized that the dragons were trembling in fear.
[If you do not wish to be enemies of Solderet, dragons, leave the battlefield immediately.]
Murakan was speaking as if Jin was on par with Solderet, declaring that Jin's enemy was Solderet's enemy.
For the dragons and magicians, this was unspeakably shocking.
In their understanding, no contractee in the world, no guardian dragon, can equate a god and a human.
Yet, no one could criticize Murakan's words and actions. There was silence for about ten seconds.
The reason the dragons did not run away while they seemed to be terrified was because Ziep was behind them. Because they had the world's number one support that could not be broken down.
[You have made your choice.]
Whooosh!
Murakan's wings grew gigantic with spiritual energy. The night sky became darker with the shadow's alien darkness, and the spreading vortexes like poison obscured the moon and the stars.
[The price is death.]
As soon as Murakan finished speaking, a horrifying scream spread from Ziep's air camp.
[Kyaaaaa!]
[Kaaaak...!]
It was the dragons screaming.
Also, the explosive sounds of the flying ships breaking and exploding were spreading.
"Damn it, suddenly from behind...!"
[Cast a protective shield!]
"Block it, block it!"
The area of the sky dominated by Murakan's spiritual energy was not just where he was floating. His spiritual energy had already taken over the airspace of Ziep and the Imperial Army.
Spiritual energy is a serene power.
Unlike other powers, including aura and magic, spiritual energy could take over all directions without showing any signs.
Ziep was hurriedly blocking Murakan's spear started from the back, but that wasn't all.
Kwaaaaa-!
The black breath cut through the sky and moved towards the front of Ziep.
"Scatter!"
Ziep's fleet split to the left and right. The intention was to disperse and avoid Murakan's breath, but they forgot about the silver dragon next to him in their fear.
Kieeeng!
Along with a sharp resonance, a silver wave began to spread from Quicantel's forehead.
The round and enormous expanding power was the power of time.
Murakan and Quicantel.
The dragons who had gone through their days as lovers knew exactly what happened when the power of shadow and time met.
Fear and destruction.
Facing the darkness of the shadow while unable to move a finger is something that makes you crave death.
"The hull has stopped... Cough, choke!"
"My arm, arm..."
[Murakan! There's no reason to go this far... Kaaaak!]
Murakan did not kill the enemies bound by the power of time in one breath.
He tormented them to make them feel pain. It was a luxury to give a comfortable death to those who dared to become Solderet's enemies despite his warnings.
Indeed, the sky was filled with blood and screams.
The enemies fighting on the ground looked up unknowingly with blank eyes, and even the allies felt chills at the overwhelming sight of Murakan.
The fleet was made up of Yangsan ships floating in the Sota desert.
The Yangsan ships, of which Jin had seen over a hundred, had not yet been revealed to the world.
Therefore, both the Imperial Army and the knights of Hairan shivered at the sight of the fleet.
But now, no matter how many more flying ships there were, they felt they couldn't overcome the power of Murakan and Quicantel.
'Can this be called a fight?'
'Isn't this... closer to punishment...!'
As people thought, Ziep's fleet was shattering, making its initial appearance of power seem meaningless.
Unable to even consider retaliating, they were overwhelmed with trying to push back the power of time and casting protective shields.
But Ziep was still Ziep.
The White Night was considered the elite unit, excluding the Specter Squad. Some of them were slowly escaping the power of time and showing attempts to retaliate.
"Form a magic circle!"
"Even if their power is all they have, withstand it! The victory will ultimately be ours!"
If they had regained all their strength, not just 50%, they wouldn't have dared to blabber like that.
The current Murakan was certainly great, but Ziep's army did not lose hope even after witnessing his power directly.
They were confident that they could eventually win, even if they suffered damage.
Even if they faced death individually, they were confident that the immense power of Ziep would eventually destroy them.
"Hold on until the main force arrives!"
"Direct attack on the Black Dragon and Silver Dragon is impossible, let's take down at least one more knight of Hairan before we die!"
"Fleet, aim at the ground!"
While dealing with spiritual energy and the power of time, they couldn't possibly attack the distance where Murakan and Quicantel were.
So, Ziep's commanders decided to attack the ground troops instead.
This decision stemmed from the certainty that, given Jin's known personality, he would never abandon his allies.
It was cowardly but the right move. As they thought, Jin would first command his forces to focus on protecting their allies.
But Ziep's commanders overlooked something.
In order to execute any plan, you need something that corresponds to it.
Power, or ability.
"Your judgment is good, but you guys don't seem to have the luxury to do that."
As soon as Jin said that,
Suddenly, a dark protective shield spread over the entire Geomhwangseong ground camp like an umbrella.
The Time Wizard, Enya.
She had deployed 'Dragon Fire Blockade', the legacy of Chucon Tolderer from Geomhwangseong's walls, the essence of extreme magic.
Enya's protective shield, which enveloped the entire front of Geomhwangseong, indeed demonstrated a performance worthy of the name 'Dragon Fire Blockade'.
The breath of Ziep's dragons merely disappeared upon collision, and the magical beams of the wizards could not penetrate the protective shield.
Chucon Tolderer, the great wizard of Anz, the Dragon Fire Blockade now was even stronger and more perfect than when he himself deployed it during his lifetime.
No matter how much of a genius Enya is, it's impossible to surpass Chucon's magic in just a few years.
Yet the reason why Enya's Dragon Fire Blockade was unfolding with a power that far surpassed his heyday was due to a single artifact that Tikan possessed.
A mirror.
Jin, who could destroy the world with its power, unlike Ziep of his previous life, had always avoided this artifact.
But it seemed he needed a little help from its power to save his friend and his people.
"Uh, ugh. The, the magic power is too much! I, I can't control it!"

"Hey, hey! You dumb thing, aren't you sober!? Do you have time to babble? Concentrate! If you mess up, you're gonna die, I'm gonna die, and those knights over there are gonna die. You got it? Did I teach you that way? Huh!? Open your eyes properly! Don't stare blankly, tie up the four points of magic, we're really falling behind!"
The one who was yelling at Enya and giving advice and assistance was none other than Beris. Despite her power loss, she was still a genius of murderous magic theory and an excellent warrior.
"Yes, yess! Masterrrr!"
"An attack is coming from the second point, block it by tying it up to the third point!"
"Yes sir!"
An infinite magic shield was defending Geomhwangseong.
Jin watched the spells of Ziep break above it and gave a cold smile.
"Ah, since the overall calculation was wrong, I guess you can't say that the judgment was good. Ziep, you guys will not achieve what you want today......"
The dragon knights, carrying the knights of Hairan, began to rush towards Ziep's army.
"I'm sorry for being late, our Hairan."
"From now on, we will prove it together. That the sword of Hairan does not break."
Dragon Knight Commander Calmain and the leader of the knights, Ruyan, raised their voices and the knights drew their swords in unison.
Emperor's Sword Technique
Sky Piercing Slash - Sword Saint
Emperor's Sword Technique
Imperial Assault - Dragon
And the sight of five Sky Piercing Slashes and the unique technique of the Dragon Knight Commander illuminating the night sky and cutting through the enemies continued.
